title: Nashik Sports Klub
summary: A race-safe booking platform for real sports inventory.
detail: A booking platform for a sports club's Pickleball and Cricket courts, built with temporary slot holds, MongoDB transactions, live availability, secure sign-in, and an automated AWS deploy.
highlights: A 500-user concurrency test committed exactly one booking for the final slot.
Atomic transactions and compound indexes protect inventory under load.
Administrators, walk-in staff, and customers each get their own workflow.

title: Ask my portfolio
summary: A portfolio you can ask questions, with the sources behind every answer.
detail: The chat on this site. It answers questions about my work from hand-reviewed passages and shows which ones it used, how well each matched, and how long every step took.
highlights: The default retriever reads passages as plain text and put a right one first on all 39 test questions.
Questions the portfolio can't answer are refused before any language model is called.
Chunking, retrieval, and the answer model were each chosen by tests on locked question sets.

title: Real-time MERN Chat
summary: Event-driven messaging with secure authentication and an AI assistant.
detail: A real-time chat app with Socket.IO messaging, Google sign-in through Firebase, JWT-secured sessions, and a Gemini assistant.
highlights: Messages are delivered live through an event-driven Socket.IO layer.
Google OAuth, Firebase, and JWTs handle sign-in and sessions.
More than 100 users have sent over 500 messages on it.
